name: 95023 · Hollister, CA
findings: ZIP 95023 (Hollister) has 136 nonprofit organizations. 65 of them (48%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 52 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (24% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 95023 (Hollister) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 95023 (Hollister) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.3 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 45 organizations here; 31% of all organizations here have no identified type.
